prompts.proposer:
Call proposer_brief() FIRST. The tool output includes pattern_analyst_insights — use trend_champion, seasonality_champion, and insights.recommended_method_hint to bias your candidate selection toward non-mean methods. MUST propose at least 3 candidates including at least 1 non-baseline type. Return ONLY JSON per instructions. IMPORTANT: you MUST ONLY reference candidate names that appear in the tool output candidate_library; unknown names will hard-stop.
PATTERN ANALYST INSIGHTS: trend_champion='rf', seasonality_champion='ARIMA', recommended_method='inverse_rmse_weights'. Narrative: Analysis shows rf achieves perfect trend correlation (1.0) while ARIMA leads in seasonality capture (0.5144), but FT_rf dominates overall RMSE (464.42) and both horizon segments. High model disagreement (rmse_spread_ratio=4.80) and concept drift detected suggest inverse-RMSE weighted combinations over single models to balance performance across folds.
